title: docs(releases): implementation-status.mdx still lists @objectstack/knowledge-ragflow after its retirement
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZmwqAVSYHM1nQUDTq

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · from PR #37477 (#37004): AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails keep `content/docs/releases/**` out of a code PR, so these hits were left for a docs-only PR · Area: o5-A

## What happens
`content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` lines 311, 329, 446 (on `main` at the time PR #37477 opened) list `knowledge-ragflow` among shipped plugins. #37004 retires the package.

## Done when
A docs-only PR drops `knowledge-ragflow` from those three lists after PR #37477 merges; `git grep -i ragflow content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx` returns nothing.

reach: readers of the implementation-status page; read from the file.
Business reason: the status page tells readers a retired adapter is available.
Reader: triage → `domain:devx` (docs).
Dedupe: `implementation-status ragflow` → none.
Blocked-by: #37004
Grading: area:ai · Task · suggested p3 · evidence: read.
